dataHandling.guidance: Use representative or appropriately governed operational data; do not paste secrets or unnecessary personal information.
dataHandling.minimization: The tool requires only the fields needed to test decision readiness.
dataHandling.retention: Browser state lasts only for the open page; reset clears in-memory state.
dataHandling.supportBoundary: The artifact is a product heuristic, not a compliance, data-governance, legal, or operational-authority determination.

risks: Users may enter sensitive operational text
Exported JSON inherits the sensitivity of entered text
A complete rubric may be mistaken for a correct decision
controls: Reset reaches a truthful empty state
Human authority and escalation remain explicit
